_doc: Combat pack (systems/combatSkills.js): Blades, Brawling, Archery, Sailing. Blades/Brawling: the weapon in your hand picks the skill (combatSkills.weaponSkill: data/duels.json weapons; fists brawl, anything else is a blade). Its level is your skill in duels (systems/duels.js: attack and defence, in place of the old flat combat number) and on the inner map (ui/innerMapCombat.js): hit = % of your swings that land (less the foe's parry/dodge), damage = % more on every blow; moves: parry (% of blows turned aside; from level 8 answered by a riposte), powerSwing (% of swings a heavy cut for powerMult), dodge (% of blows slipped), stagger (% of hits that cost the foe their next blow), haymaker (a hit that leaves the foe under this % of their strength knocks them out). Archery (ui/actionMenu/jobs.js hunting shots, systems/festivals.js archery contest, player/fieldBattle.js): aim = points on every hunting shot's accuracy (and in the contest), draw = % force of your arrows: your own share of a battle's opening volley when you carry a bow (fieldBattle personal.volleyWeight of it) and the contest, steady = a shot short of the mark by no more than this still strikes, secondArrow = % chance to loose again after a miss (fresh aim, half the gap closed). The festival contests: archery by your Archery level, jousting by Blades. Sailing (systems/ships.js, shipVoyages.js) aboard your own ship: speed = % faster voyages, stormHold = % of the way a storm would cost you kept, stormSafety = % less hull damage, cargo washed out and sailors lost in a storm, crew = % less morale lost to storms, % less stamina sailing by hand, % to the crew in a fight. combatSkills.migrate: an old save's flat combat skill seeds levels (level = combat × rate); later rises in the old combat number (training, bounties, battles) feed in as rate × a level's XP; and the old number is kept at least your best fighting level. combatSkills.inner: npcHitBonus added to an NPC's hit chance; minHit/maxHit clamp every blow's chance; npcLevelWeight: attack per level an NPC is above (or below) the usual for their kind (defence 0.7 of it).

blades.name: Blades
blades.desc: Swords, axes, knives, spears, hammers: any weapon in the hand. Your level is your skill in duels. Learned by every blow struck in a fight, by duels and by training.

powerSwing.text: Power swing: {v}% of swings a heavy cut

riposte.text: Riposte: a parried blow is answered at once

brawling.name: Brawling
brawling.desc: Fists, elbows and dirty tricks. Your level is your skill in a fist fight. Learned by every punch thrown and every knockout.

stagger.text: Stagger: {v}% of hits cost them their next blow

haymaker.text: Haymaker: a hit that leaves them under {v}% knocks them out

archery.name: Archery
archery.desc: The bow: hunting shots, and your own arrows in a battle's opening volley. Learned by every arrow loosed, more by those that strike home.

steady.text: Steady: a near miss (within {v}) still strikes home

secondArrow.text: Second arrow: {v}% chance to loose again after a miss

sailing.name: Sailing
sailing.desc: Sheets, helm and weather on your own ship. Learned by every day at sea, most of all in a storm, and by making port.

stormHold.text: keep {a}% more way in a storm
stormHold.show: {v}% of a storm's lost way kept
